Champagne glasses clink and the curtains rise. The music builds, and in a cloud of feathers and sequins, the dancers make their entrance. Let the spectacle of senses begin!

As the pages turn and it evolves on the skin, a subdued mahogany and leather bring up the rear. Daring but not brash or loud; complex yet never persnickety. It's a sure-bet for a modern classic.

This fragrance is titled Shukran, an Arabic word that means thank you. The goal of this fragrance is to remember Morocco's mint tea ritual, in the bars of Marrakech; the easiest way to get to know each other, understand and build a dialogue. 2# Nota Di Viaggio 'Shukran', can be worn throughout the year, but its energy is released best in the hot seasons, both day and night. JovoyÕs new fragrance, Ò21 Conduit StÓ, revisits a great classic of English perfumery while giving it a new, intriguing and decidedly modern twist. He dreamt of giving it greater contrast, making it more multi-facetted, upping the tangy, fruity freshness and warming it through with resinous notes. ÒItÕs a lavender thatÕs chiseled from the freshness of cold, crisp oranges, the cheekiness of cassis and the bittersweet comforting warmth of pineÓ Marlow explains.

Sweet and happy memories came to mind as I opened the creaky wooden gate to the family garden. It had been years since I had been there. I sat comfortably in the shade of the tall cypress tree, as we used to do. I abandoned myself to the comforting feeling of belonging to the place. I breathed deeply. It was the scent of happiness at dawn.

A road trip through the "riviera". It was like blending into the backdrop of a 1960s French film as I drove along those little-travelled roads winding up and down through the unspoilt countryside. As I rounded the last bend, I thought of you, of the dinner we would have at our secret spot by the sea, and I could almost smell its pleasant aroma.

I recognized the long avenue lined with tall trees for the first time by its unmistakable aroma. I walked past the old tobacco factory that once inspired the novel, Carmen. I entered the narrow streets of the neighborhood. I boldly pushed open a studded wooden door, revealing the most sumptuous courtyard I had ever seen. An unforgettable scented scene.

description: In the nautical world, the Italian word ÔabbrivioÕ means headway and refers to the inertial motion of a boat. When a boat starts to move, in fact, its thrusters have to overcome an immense inertia, generated by the weight and shape of the boat itself, immersed in the water. Let us imagine TeleaÕs unfurled sails swelling to pull the mast fixed to its deck forward, thanks to the sheer power of the wind, but in moments that sometimes seem eternal, nothing happens and the boat remains motionless; then suddenly and with a momentum of its own, not governed by man, the boat generates motion. This thrust is the headway: difficult to get going, but then almost unstoppable. There are two types of headway, increasing and decreasing, both of which are daughters of the same mother and which a good sailor must come to terms with in order to sail safely. The headway is a magic trick of motion that has always fascinated seafarers because of its beauty that is not fully revealed and is ever changing and fickle depending on the weather conditions. Every boat has its own soul and therefore its own headway, which can never be the same as any other. A kind of inimitable, unique fingerprint, just as the creation inspired by it is inimitable and unique. This magical and unpredictable, mysterious and inexplicable force is fully encapsulated in the Starfish Collection bottle. Just like the force of the unstoppable headway that can only be controlled by expert hands, this creation can be discovered by profound connoisseurs of the art of perfumery.

In Greek mythology, the Heliades were the daughters of Helios (God of the Sun) and Clymene. After the tragic death of their brother, Phaethon, the Heliades grieved for four months yet were still blamed for playing a role in their brother's death. As a result, the gods turned them into poplar trees and their tears into amber. The tears, which fell into the river Eridanos in the form of amber pearls, were then found and used to adorn Roman brides. This amber, born out of sadness yet then used to create beauty in times of joy and celebration, is exactly what inspired the creation of Amber Oud.

description: Tiziana and Paolo’s intergalactic journey to discover the celestial emotions produced by magical stellar fires continues. Stars, in fact, are luminous fires that shine in the celestial sphere, lighting up our nights. Comets boast a distinctive, legendary charm, with their light able to bring gifts of joy, hope and good fortune to mankind and those who have eyes to see them. This marvellous creation is inspired by the famous Comet Borelly, a celestial body composed mainly of ice and stardust, which moves through our solar system following an elliptical shape. Its most distinctive feature is its bright tail, which increases in intensity and iridescence as it approaches the Sun in its meanderings. It has an asymmetrical shape that further characterises its beauty, passing over periodically at varying time intervals due to the influence of Jupiter’s gravitational pull on its orbit. This makes our comet’s journey even more mysterious and it is hard to predict its next appearance, but today we can enjoy its magical influence thanks to this creation! Comets are, in fact, the source of many legends, associated with extraordinary events and auspicious changes for mankind, and this creation releases all its magic and strength in the same way, emphasising the wearer’s positive energy and irresistible charm. The fragrance opens with an elegant, persuasive floral bouquet emphasised by the scent of citrus fruits, where the notes of Reggio Calabrian Bergamot and Sicilian Mandarin are complemented by the tropical vibration of Indian Frangipani, opulently enriched by the seductive power of Natural Citrus Aldehydes. The generous head rests on an equally rich and seductive heart where hypnotic Mexican Tuberose embraces the disturbing combination of Bulgarian Rose and Ylang Ylang, enriched by the persistence of Italian Violet and Lily of the Valley. The base of this magical potion of seduction is rooted in graceful, precious woods where Tuscan Birch and African Ebony immediately emerge, enhanced by the muted aroma of Musk, with reverberations of Australian Sandalwood and Madagascar Vanilla. Borelli is the Comet perfume that will give you the power of seduction and timeless elegance.

All of us have wished, or can wish, that an instant would stop to last in time. We all would love to have Òencore du temps.Ó As always with the creations by Meo Fusciuni Parfums, the Italian maison of artistic perfumery, Encore du temps is the olfactory story of a direct experience and of many thoughts that a journey brings, the fruit of research and of a set of emotions, feelings and perceptions collected in a perfume that aspires to be the custodian of memory and the start of a new route. Encore du temps focuses for the first time, among the themes dear to Meo Fusciuni, on the feeling of love and itÕs the second chapter of the Trilogia senza Tempo collection, dedicated to the physical and mental journey through three different olfactory worlds: India, Laos and Japan. Oud is the quintessence of woody notes. It is unique by its olfactive profile and sociocultural interest. I wanted to work around oud as a multifaceted diamond, the most precious raw material you can imagine. I had the chance to work with an amazing quality of Oud from Ajmal, located in India. It is the perfect balance of all the facets of oud: smoky, leathery, slightly animalic, vibrant, addictive and powerful. What makes this fragrance perfectly unique is the fresh floral Magnolia Ð Lilybelle accord in the heart, projecting the fragrance to a more bright, enthusiast and joyful place. Lilybelle¨ in particular, gives an almost aquatic character to the fragrance, which allows the perfume to breathe. Afterwards, I used an overdose of Ambrocenide¨ and Ambrostar¨, that provide a unique sharpness, projection and vibrance. These molecules can virtually make this fragrance last forever. Then, I choose a combination of three exceptional woody raw materials: Patchouly heart fraction to convey the darkness of oud, Sandalwood Album to impart an addictive soft and milky sandalwood effect, and finally our precious Vetiver from Madagascar, that possess an earthy, rooty, and slightly smoky impression. description: Tiziana Terenzi's Anniversary Collection is inspired by events and people who have positively influenced the lives of Tiziana and Paolo. Influences and emotions transformed into fragrance extracts made with the oldest technique of Italian artistic perfumery, following the teachings handed down from generation to generation, from father to son, jealously guarding all the secrets and arcana of the family. This has been the case in the Terenzi family for centuries and will be so for future generations. Thanks to the power of nature from where we cultivate and extract our most precious and genuine ingredients, every year we create a limited and unique collection, unrepeatable but at the same time eternal. From this collection we can remember the famous fragrances inspired by our dear grandparents, Bigia and Gumin, or the famous Casanova and even the two extracts inspired by the works of the great director Federico Fellini, along with many other very special moments, able to evoke universal and positive emotions, simply pure wonder. The fortunate and creative encounter with their dear friend and international artist Kristina Orbakaite resulted in a moment of unique and unrepeatable inspiration that today we find enclosed in a bottle that is also unique and unrepeatable. The fusion of the souls of these artists and their disciplines gives life to a perfume extract that captures the essence of art and seductive elegance, in an embrace between different cultures. description: I have created many compositions with oud Ñ each with its own soul. But never before had the oud note in my work been so intense and primal as in the creation of Lao Oud. A few years ago, I was fortunate to acquire a rare oil from Laos Ñ a material with the scent of honey and blossoms, layered with an unmistakable feral depth. IÕve visited Laos more than twenty times. It is a serene and hospitable land, where time seems to have slowed to a 19th-century rhythm. The memory of its ancient monasteries, its misty mornings, and the warmth of its people became the backdrop for this composition. The central note Ñ Laotian oud Ñ is remarkably close to Indian oud in depth, but softer and more harmonious. I paired it with Laotian coffee, frangipani, pink pepper, and cinnamon. Wisps of incense, reminiscent of those rising from golden temple rooftops, complete the picture. This is how Lao Oud was born Ñ a fragrant walk through Vientiane, the quiet capital on the banks of the Mekong. Perhaps the most intensely oud-forward and coffee-rich fragrance in the Bortnikoff collection, Lao Oud is a journey captured in scent Ñ full of memory, warmth, and complexity.

description: In its relentless pursuit to redefine the paradigms of scent creation, NISHANE introduces Shinanay as the second opus in its Experimental Collection. Launched in 2019, the Experimental Collection serves as a daring space for avant-garde creations, offering perfumers and the most discerning connoisseurs alike the opportunity to surpass their limits and explore uncharted olfactory territories. Following Unutamam, the provocateur and unforgettable fougere, the addition of Shinanay further solidifies NISHANE's reputation as a trailblazer in the world of perfumery. Hemmed with tactile balsams and caramelised resins, a heart of narcotic flowers - Gardenia, Tuberose and Magnolia Ð lilts through the composition, its indolic sweetness pulsing against the luminous verticality of Galbanum and Lily of the Valley. An interplay of contrasts arises, between the lime-green freshness of Mastic and Elemi and the warmth of Capes and Opoponax, their toffee and chocolate hues distilled into a voluptuous ambery glaze. Indian Sandalwood and Himalayan Cedar burnish the exhausted petals, lending their milkiness to the arousing purr of Civet while Oakmoss, in a final, tenebrous waft, responds to the aldehydic Citruses of the overture.

The Divine Sarah, as she was known, was universally described as flamboyant, avant-gardist and charismatic and these three traits are captured by the three main accords of this Parfum Intense. The Flamboyant accord is a spicy blend of opulence and sophistication powered by the glamourous combination of turmeric seeds and incense Orpurª that open the scent with an unforgettable signature. The Avant-gardist accord is a sumptuous blend of iris Orpurª enhanced by the unexpected, addictive caramel and amber notes of Rosyfolia Orpurª which add a warm, resinous depth. The Charismatic accord combines captivating notes of Coumarine and premium-quality vanilla, finished by Akigalawood for an enchantingly soft, mesmerising trail. Part of the Atkinsons 1799 Reserve Collection, Shine Despite Everything is a glorious, glamourous fragrance dedicated to those who, like the Divine Sarah, do not fear glory and face life with tenacity and intensity.
